questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
कथन 1 : सीमांत उपभोग प्रवृत्ति (MPC) से तात्पर्य प्रति आय इकाई उपभोग से है।
कथन 2 : आय में वृद्धि के फलस्वरूप, उपभोग के स्तर में आनुपातिक वृद्धि सदैव आय के स्तर में वृद्धि से अधिक होती है।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement 1: Marginal Propensity to Consume (MPC) refers to the consumption per unit of income.
Statement 2: As the income increases, the proportionate increase in the level of consumption is always more than the increase in the level of income.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Statement 1 is false because MPC refers to the change in consumption per unit change in income, not average consumption. Statement 2 is false because the marginal propensity to consume is always less than one, meaning consumption increases less than the increase in income. Therefore, both statements are false.

questions.text: प्राथमिक घाटे के मापन का मुख्य उद्देश्य वर्तमान _______ पर ध्यान केन्द्रित करना है।

questions.instruction_line_english: (Choose the correct option to fill in the blank)
questions.solution: The primary deficit is calculated as the fiscal deficit minus interest payments. Its main objective is to focus on the fiscal imbalances of the government by excluding the burden of past debt interest, so option A is the correct answer.

दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement 1: Import of heavy machinery from Japan is a source of demand for foreign exchange.
Statement 2: Financial aid by International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) for landslide in Wayanad (Kerala) is a source of supply of foreign exchange.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Import of goods requires payment in foreign currency, creating demand (Statement 1 true). Inward financial aid represents a receipt of foreign currency, creating supply (Statement 2 true). Thus, both statements are true.

questions.solution: In a basic two-sector economy (households and firms), Aggregate Demand is defined as the sum of consumption expenditure (C) and investment expenditure (I). Therefore, option A is correct.

कथन 1 : सरकार किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में प्रचलित अपस्फीतिकारी अंतराल को नियंत्रित करने के लिए, रेपो दर में कमी कर सकती है।
कथन 2 : सरकार खुले बाज़ार में सरकारी प्रतिभूतियों (G-Sec) की बिक्री द्वारा, अपस्फीतिकारी अंतराल में कमी कर सकती है।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement 1: The government may reduce the repo rate, to control deflationary gap prevailing in the economy.
Statement 2: The government may reduce the deflationary gap, by selling off government securities (G-Sec) in the open market.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Reducing the repo rate increases liquidity to combat deflation (Statement 1 true). Selling government securities in the open market reduces liquidity, which would worsen a deflationary gap, not reduce it (Statement 2 false).

दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement 1: Public goods are those goods for which the payments are made by all the entities in the country.
Statement 2: Private goods are those goods which are provided by the government of a country at subsidised rates.
In the light of the given statements, choose the correct option from the following:

options.A: कथन 1 सत्य है और कथन 2 असत्य है।
options.B: कथन 1 असत्य है और कथन 2 सत्य है।

options_english.A: Statement 1 is true and Statement 2 is false.
options_english.B: Statement 1 is false and Statement 2 is true.

questions.solution: Public goods are non-excludable and non-rivalrous, usually provided by government, not paid for by every individual directly (Statement 1 false). Private goods are usually provided by the private market at equilibrium prices, not generally subsidized (Statement 2 false). Both are incorrect.

निम्नलिखित कथनों - अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) का अध्ययन कीजिए।
अभिकथन (A): प्रत्यक्ष कर व्यक्तियों/कम्पनियों की आय/लाभ पर आरोपित किए जाते हैं।
कारण (R) : प्रत्यक्ष करों के भुगतान का बोझ किसी अन्य इकाई पर स्थानांतरित नहीं किया जा सकता है।

Read the following statements - Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A): Direct taxes are imposed on income/profits of individuals/companies.
Reason (R): The burden of payment of direct taxes cannot be shifted to any other entity.
questions.instruction_line: नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, लेकिन कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Direct taxes like income tax are imposed on the person who pays them, and the defining characteristic of a direct tax is that its burden cannot be shifted to others (non-transferability). Thus, the reason correctly explains the assertion.

questions.text: "आय की असमानताओं को कम करने के लिए कराधान एक प्रभावी उपकरण है।" वैध कारणों द्वारा दिए गए कथन का औचित्य सिद्ध कीजिए।
questions.text_english: "Taxation is an effective tool to reduce income inequalities." Justify the given statement with valid reasons.

key_points: Redistribution of income through social welfare schemes

questions.solution: Taxation acts as an effective tool for reducing income inequality through a progressive tax structure where higher income earners are taxed at higher rates. The revenue generated by the government through these taxes is then used to fund public welfare schemes, social security, and infrastructure for the poor. Furthermore, taxing luxuries and wealth transfers resources from the affluent to the needy, thereby narrowing the gap between rich and poor classes.

sub_questions.text_english: (a) Explain any two precautions pertaining to the Value Added Method of Estimation of National Income in a country.

key_points: Avoid double counting of intermediate goods.
Include the value of output produced for self-consumption.

sub_questions.solution: One major precaution in the value-added method is to avoid double counting, which occurs when the value of intermediate goods is counted more than once; therefore, only the value added by each firm must be summed. A second precaution is to include the estimated value of production for self-consumption, such as owner-occupied housing or agricultural produce kept by farmers for their own family's use, as this represents real economic activity.

questions.solution: Value-added method precautions include avoiding double counting and including self-consumption value.

questions.text_english:
(a) Elaborate any two components of the Capital Account under the Balance of Payments Account.
OR
(b) Distinguish between Autonomous transactions and Accommodating transactions.

key_points: Capital Account: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI), Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI), External Commercial Borrowings (ECB).
Autonomous vs Accommodating: Profit motive vs Balancing motive, above the line vs below the line items.

questions.solution:
(a) Two components of the Capital Account are Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) and External Commercial Borrowings (ECB). FDI refers to investments made by foreign entities to acquire a lasting interest in an enterprise operating in another economy. External Commercial Borrowings are loans from non-resident lenders to Indian entities, which increase the country's foreign exchange liabilities. Both affect the capital account balance.
(OR)
(b) Autonomous transactions are those international economic transactions that are undertaken with the motive of profit maximization, independent of the balance of payments status ('above the line'). In contrast, accommodating transactions are those undertaken to maintain the balance in the Balance of Payments account, specifically to offset the deficits or surpluses caused by autonomous transactions ('below the line').

निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
एक शोध संस्था द्वारा निर्गमित एक रिपोर्ट में कहा गया है कि अर्थव्यवस्था में समग्र माँग, विशेषकर निजी उपभोग खंड में, तीव्र गिरावट आई है। वृहद् आर्थिक चरों में यह कमी, आर्थिक गतिविधियों को प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए रणनीतिक कार्यवाहियों की तत्काल आवश्यकता को परिलक्षित करती है।
दिए गए गद्य तथा सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर, उन उपायों की व्याख्या कीजिए जिन्हें सरकार संकेतिक समस्या को ठीक करने के लिए उठा सकती है।
questions.text_english:
Read the following text carefully :
According to a report issued by a research organisation, there is a sharp decline in the overall demand in the economy, particularly in the private consumption segment. This dip in the macro economic variables, highlights the urgent need for strategic actions to stimulate economic activities.
On the basis of the given text and common understanding, explain the measure which the government may take to solve the indicated problem.

key_points: Reduction in taxes to boost disposable income
Monetary policy support (e.g., lower interest rates)

questions.solution: To address the decline in aggregate demand, the government should adopt an expansionary fiscal policy. The primary measure involves increasing government spending on infrastructure and social projects, which directly adds to aggregate demand and creates jobs. Additionally, the government can reduce direct taxes, thereby increasing the disposable income of households, which encourages private consumption. Furthermore, coordinating with the central bank to ensure a lower interest rate environment would reduce the cost of borrowing, further stimulating private investment and consumption. These strategic actions combined provide the necessary stimulus to revive economic activity and restore growth.

questions.text:
एक काल्पनिक अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए निम्नलिखित को मानते हुए, सम-स्तर आय व संतुलन आय के स्तरों का अनुमान लगाइए :
(i) स्वायत्त उपभोग व्यय (c̄) = ₹ 50 करोड़
(ii) सीमांत बचत प्रवृत्ति (MPS) = 0.2
(iii) स्वायत्त निवेश (I0) = ₹ 300 करोड़
questions.text_english:
Assuming the following for a hypothetical economy, estimate the level of Break-even Income and Equilibrium Income:
(i) Autonomous Consumption Expenditure (c̄) = ₹ 50 crore
(ii) Marginal Propensity to Save (MPS) = 0.2
(iii) Autonomous Investments (I0) = ₹ 300 crore

key_points: Break-even Income (Y) = Autonomous Consumption / (1 - MPC) = c̄ / MPS = 50 / 0.2 = 250

questions.solution: Given the autonomous consumption c̄ = 50, MPS = 0.2, and I0 = 300, we first find the MPC = 1 - MPS = 0.8. The break-even income is where Consumption equals Income, calculated as Y = c̄ / MPS = 50 / 0.2 = ₹ 250 crore. The equilibrium income is where Aggregate Demand equals Aggregate Supply, calculated using the multiplier formula as Y = (c̄ + I0) / MPS = (50 + 300) / 0.2 = 350 / 0.2 = ₹ 1750 crore.

sub_questions.text_english: "The disposition phase of the circular flow of income involves the flow of factor income from firms to households." Justify the statement giving valid reasons.

key_points: Disposition phase refers to expenditure by households.
Factor income flow occurs in the Distribution/Income phase.

sub_questions.solution: This statement is incorrect. The circular flow of income has three phases: production, distribution (income), and disposition (expenditure). The flow of factor income from firms to households occurs in the distribution (income) phase, not the disposition phase. The disposition phase specifically involves the expenditure of income by households on goods and services produced by firms.

sub_questions.text_english: Discuss the likely impact of construction of 20 new hospitals in a country on the Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and Welfare in the economy.

key_points: GDP increases due to investment and construction activity.
Welfare increases due to better healthcare access and improved human capital.

sub_questions.solution: The construction of 20 new hospitals will lead to a direct increase in Gross Domestic Product (GDP) due to the investment expenditure and economic activity generated during the construction and operation phases. Simultaneously, this project significantly enhances economic welfare by improving public access to healthcare, leading to a healthier population, higher productivity, and better quality of life, which are critical components of social welfare.

questions.solution: For part (a)(i), calculation of NDP_FC is performed by summing final expenditures and adjusting for net indirect taxes and net factor income. For (a)(ii), the disposition phase relates to expenditure, not income distribution. For (b)(ii), hospital construction boosts both GDP through investment and welfare through improved healthcare.

questions.solution: Poverty in Pakistan has emerged due to several factors. Firstly, the economy remains overly dependent on agriculture, which is susceptible to weather-related shocks. questions.text_english:
(a) "Under British rule, India underwent systematic economic exploitation, with its resources and wealth being transferred to Britain." Justify the given statement with valid explanation.
OR
(b) Appraise the Navratna policy adopted by the Government of India in the 1991 reforms.
questions.solution: (a) Under British rule, India was reduced to an exporter of raw materials and an importer of finished British goods, which destroyed domestic handicrafts and stunted industrial growth. The 'Drain of Wealth' through heavy taxation and high administrative costs ensured that India's wealth was systematically diverted to finance the British empire, leading to stagnation and poverty. (OR) (b) The Navratna policy was a strategic move by the Government of India to grant greater operational and financial autonomy to selected high-performing Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). This allowed these enterprises to become globally competitive, modernize their operations, and expand, successfully transforming many into profitable corporate entities in the post-1991 reform era.

questions.text:
दिए गए गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए व निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
तीव्र गति से वृद्धिमान जनसंख्या के प्रति-उत्तर में, चीन ने 'एकल संतान नीति' प्रारंभ की थी। इस नीति के अंतर्गत युगलों (couples) को केवल एक ही संतान पैदा करने की अनुमति प्रदान की गई थी। इस नीति ने चीन को जनसंख्या वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने में सहायता की थी।
इस नीति के महत्त्वपूर्ण परिणाम भी उत्पन्न हुए, जैसे कि वृद्धों की अधिक जनसंख्या, पुत्रों को प्राथमिकता देने के कारण लिंग असंतुलन एवं एकल संतानों के लिए सामाजिक चुनौतियाँ आदि ।
2015 में इस नीति में ढील दी गई, जिससे सभी युगलों को दो संतान पैदा करने की अनुमति मिल गई थी तथा 2021 में इसे और शिथिल करके तीन संतानों तक कर दिया गया था।
कुल मिलाकर, जबकि एकल संतान नीति ने जनसंख्या वृद्धि को नियंत्रित करने के अपने प्राथमिक लक्ष्य को प्राप्त किया था, परन्तु इसने जनसांख्यिकीय व सामाजिक चुनौतियों का एक जटिल समूह भी उत्पन्न किया जिसका सामना चीन आज भी कर रहा है।

This policy was relaxed in 2015, allowing all couples to have two children and further relaxed to three children in 2021.
Overall, while the One Child Policy achieved its primary goal of controlling population growth, it also created a complex set of demographic and social challenges that China continues to address today.

sub_questions.solution: The implementation of the One Child Policy had significant demographic and social consequences. It led to an increase in the proportion of the ageing population, a marked gender imbalance resulting from a societal preference for male children, and various social challenges for single children who faced the burden of caring for elderly relatives alone.

questions.text_english:
(a) (i) Distinguish between human capital and physical capital.
(ii) Describe 'LPG' and 'Gobar Gas' as strategies used to achieve sustainable development in rural areas.
OR
(b) (i) Critically appraise the micro-credit programmes in rural India.
(ii) State the meaning of sustainable development.

sub_questions.text: (i) मानव पूँजी व भौतिक पूँजी में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (i) Distinguish between human capital and physical capital.

key_points: Human capital: Skills, education, health of people.

sub_questions.solution: Human capital refers to the intangible skills, knowledge, education, and health possessed by individuals that contribute to production, whereas physical capital consists of tangible assets like machinery, buildings, and technology. Human capital is embodied within the individual, while physical capital is an external asset that can be separated from the owner.

sub_questions.text: (ii) ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में 'LPG' व 'गोबर गैस' का धारणीय विकास प्राप्त करने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली रणनीति के रूप में वर्णन कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (ii) Describe 'LPG' and 'Gobar Gas' as strategies used to achieve sustainable development in rural areas.

key_points: Use agricultural waste as fuel (circular economy).

sub_questions.solution: LPG and Gobar Gas serve as cleaner energy sources compared to traditional biomass fuels like firewood. By reducing reliance on wood, they decrease deforestation and improve health outcomes by reducing indoor air pollution. Furthermore, Gobar Gas converts agricultural/animal waste into usable energy and manure, promoting a circular economy and supporting sustainable development in rural regions.

questions.solution: See sub-questions for individual answers. (a)(i) Differentiates between embodied human capabilities and external assets. (a)(ii) Highlights the role of clean fuels in reducing pollution and deforestation. (b)(i) Micro-credit enables small enterprises but has challenges like limited reach/high costs. (b)(ii) Sustainable development is development that meets present needs without compromising future generations.

मान्य तर्कों द्वारा, उल्लेख व विस्तृत व्याख्या कीजिए कि निम्नलिखित कथन सत्य हैं अथवा असत्य :
(क) जैविक कृषि, महँगे कृषि आगतों को स्थानीय स्तर पर उत्पादित जैविक आगतों से प्रतिस्थापित करने का एक साधन प्रदान करती है।
(ख) भारत में कार्यबल के अनौपचारिकीकरण ने देश के युवाओं के मध्य रोज़गार सृजन के मोर्चे पर विभिन्न चिंताओं में वृद्धि की है।
questions.text_english:
State and elaborate whether the following statements are true/false, with valid arguments:
(a) Organic farming offers a means to substitute costlier agricultural inputs with locally produced organic inputs.
(b) Informalisation of workforce in India, has increased various concerns on the front of employment generation among the youth of the country.

sub_questions.text: (क) जैविक कृषि, महँगे कृषि आगतों को स्थानीय स्तर पर उत्पादित जैविक आगतों से प्रतिस्थापित करने का एक साधन प्रदान करती है।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) Organic farming offers a means to substitute costlier agricultural inputs with locally produced organic inputs.

key_points: Uses manure/compost instead of chemical fertilizers/pesticides.

sub_questions.solution: This statement is true. Organic farming relies on natural processes, using compost, manure, and biological pest control, which are produced locally and are cheaper compared to expensive synthetic chemical fertilizers and pesticides. This transition significantly lowers the cost of production for farmers and promotes long-term soil sustainability.

sub_questions.text: (ख) भारत में कार्यबल के अनौपचारिकीकरण ने देश के युवाओं के मध्य रोज़गार सृजन के मोर्चे पर विभिन्न चिंताओं में वृद्धि की है।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Informalisation of workforce in India, has increased various concerns on the front of employment generation among the youth of the country.

key_points: Lack of job security/benefits in informal sector.

sub_questions.solution: This statement is true. The informalization of the workforce means more workers are engaged in sectors without formal job contracts, lack of legal protection, no access to social security benefits, and lower job security. This trend creates deep concern for the youth, as it results in unstable, low-wage employment with little room for professional growth or financial security.

questions.solution: Both statements are true. (a) Discusses input cost reduction through local organic inputs. (b) Discusses labor insecurity and lack of benefits in the informal economy.

questions.text:
(क) (i) "1991 के उपरांत अवधि में भारत सरकार द्वारा अपनाई गई विनिवेश नीति से भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था अत्यंत लाभान्वित हुई है।" मान्य तर्कों द्वारा दिए गए कथन का समर्थन या खंडन कीजिए।
(ii) प्रशुल्क (Tariffs) व कोटा (Quotas) में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) (i) 1991 के उपरांत अवधि में भारत सरकार द्वारा लागू किए गए वित्तीय क्षेत्र के सुधारों की संक्षेप में चर्चा कीजिए।
(ii) बहुपक्षीय व्यापार व द्वि-पक्षीय व्यापार में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) (i) "The Indian economy has hugely benefitted from the disinvestment policy adopted by the Government of India in the post-1991 period." Defend or refute the given statement with valid arguments.
(ii) Distinguish between Tariffs and Quotas.
OR
(b) (i) Discuss briefly the financial sector reforms undertaken by the Government of India in the post-1991 period.
(ii) Distinguish between Multilateral Trade and Bilateral Trade.

sub_questions.text: (i) "1991 के उपरांत अवधि में भारत सरकार द्वारा अपनाई गई विनिवेश नीति से भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था अत्यंत लाभान्वित हुई है।" मान्य तर्कों द्वारा दिए गए कथन का समर्थन या खंडन कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (i) "The Indian economy has hugely benefitted from the disinvestment policy adopted by the Government of India in the post-1991 period." Defend or refute the given statement with valid arguments.

key_points: Arguments for: Efficient use of assets, fiscal health, better management.
Arguments against: Social impact, potential job losses.

sub_questions.solution: The disinvestment policy can be defended as beneficial because it allows for the more efficient use of resources by transferring management of loss-making public units to the private sector. It helps improve fiscal health by generating government revenue and introduces professional management, innovation, and competitiveness to the units, ultimately leading to higher productivity in the economy.

sub_questions.text: (ii) प्रशुल्क (Tariffs) व कोटा (Quotas) में अंतर स्पष्ट कीजिए।
sub_questions.solution: Tariffs are taxes imposed on imported goods to increase their price and discourage imports, thereby protecting domestic industries. Quotas are quantitative restrictions that limit the volume or quantity of specific goods that can be imported into a country during a specific period. While both restrict trade, tariffs function through price mechanisms, whereas quotas function through quantity controls.

questions.solution: (a)(i) Supports disinvestment via fiscal efficiency and competitive management. (a)(ii) Explains tariff as price tax and quota as quantity limit. (b)(i) Discusses shift from RBI control to financial liberalization and role of regulators. (b)(ii) Defines multilateral as involving many countries vs bilateral involving two.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित गद्य का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिए :
आवधिक श्रम बल सर्वेक्षण के आँकड़ों के अनुसार, विगत छः वर्षों में, भारतीय श्रम बाज़ार संकेतकों में सुधार हुआ है। 2022 - 23 में बेरोज़गारी दर घट कर 3.2% हो गई है। कार्यबल में युवाओं व महिलाओं की भागीदारी में वृद्धि से जनसांख्यिकीय व लैंगिक लाभांश का लाभ उठाने के अवसर प्राप्त हुए हैं। फैक्ट्री रोज़गार आँकड़े वित्तीय वर्ष 2022 - 23 में संगठित विनिर्माण क्षेत्र में उछाल को दर्शाते हैं इसके साथ ही रोज़गार में वृद्धि व कारखानों का विस्तार सम्मिलित है।
विगत पाँच वर्षों में EPFO के अंतर्गत शुद्ध वेतन प्राप्त करने वाले दोगुने से अधिक हो गए हैं, जो कि स्वस्थ विकास व औपचारिक रोज़गार का संकेत है।
गुणवत्तापूर्ण रोज़गार सृजन करने व उसे बनाए रखने के लिए कृषि-प्रसंस्करण व देखभाल अर्थव्यवस्था के दो आशाजनक विकल्प हैं।
दिए गए गद्य व सामान्य ज्ञान के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
(क) भारतीय कार्यबल में बढ़ती हुई युवा व महिला भागीदारी का कोई एक महत्त्व बताइए ।
(ख) भारत में गुणवत्तापूर्ण रोज़गार सृजन हेतु आशाजनक माने जाने वाले किन्हीं दो क्षेत्रों की पहचान कीजिए ।
(ग) उपयुक्त उदाहरण की सहायता से प्रच्छन्न बेरोज़गारी के अर्थ की विस्तृत व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Read the following text carefully :
Indian labour market indicators have improved in the last six years, as per the Periodic Labour Force Survey Data. The unemployment rate has fallen to 3.2% in 2022-23. Rising youth and female participation in the workforce present an opportunity to tap the demographic and gender dividend. The factory employment data exhibits the bounce back of the organised manufacturing sector in FY 2022 - 23 with rise in employment and the upscaling of factories.
The net payroll additions under EPFO have more than doubled in the past five years, signalling healthy growth in formal employment.
To generate and sustain quality employment, agro-processing and care economy are two promising candidates.
On the basis of the given text and common understanding, answer the following questions :
(a) State any one significance of rising youth and female participation in the Indian workforce.
(b) Identify any two sectors which may be highlighted as promising for generating quality employment in India.
(c) Elaborate the meaning of disguised unemployment with the help of a suitable example.

sub_questions.text: (क) भारतीय कार्यबल में बढ़ती हुई युवा व महिला भागीदारी का कोई एक महत्त्व बताइए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) State any one significance of rising youth and female participation in the Indian workforce.

key_points: Harnessing the demographic and gender dividend.

sub_questions.solution: The rising participation of youth and women is significant as it provides a major opportunity for India to harness its demographic and gender dividend, leading to higher economic output.

sub_questions.text: (ख) भारत में गुणवत्तापूर्ण रोज़गार सृजन हेतु आशाजनक माने जाने वाले किन्हीं दो क्षेत्रों की पहचान कीजिए ।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Identify any two sectors which may be highlighted as promising for generating quality employment in India.
sub_questions.solution: Based on the text, the two promising sectors for generating quality employment are agro-processing and the care economy.

sub_questions.text: (ग) उपयुक्त उदाहरण की सहायता से प्रच्छन्न बेरोज़गारी के अर्थ की विस्तृत व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (c) Elaborate the meaning of disguised unemployment with the help of a suitable example.

key_points: Situation where more people are working than required.

sub_questions.solution: Disguised unemployment is a situation where more people are engaged in a job than actually required. If these extra people were removed, the total output would remain unchanged, meaning their marginal productivity is zero. For example, in many Indian agricultural families, five members may work on a field that actually needs only three; the two extra workers are disguisedly unemployed as their contribution to total production is nil.
